reason: ADR v1.0.0 documents 16 architectural decisions that are well-aligned with SAD §1-§3, SAD §5 SAB, SAD §6 STRIDE-lite, and SRS FR-01..FR-05 + NFR-01..NFR-10. Each ADR carries Status/Context/Decision/Consequences and a substantive Alternatives-considered block (an addition beyond the template). Layering (ADR-002), single store boundary (ADR-003), atomic write (ADR-004), flock (ADR-005), schema migration (ADR-006), ThreadPoolExecutor (ADR-007), breaker (ADR-008), injectable sleep (ADR-009), no shell=True (ADR-010), redaction (ADR-011), centralized config (ADR-012), --inject-fault (ADR-013), cache signature (ADR-014), exit-code policy (ADR-015), and one-site fault isolation (ADR-016) all map back to specific SAD §2.2.x responsibilities and SRS §3/§4 requirements. Four low-severity nits flagged
